events.before: Help Center Help Center Plastic CNC Machining PMMA (Acrylic) CNC Machining Help Center Ordering CNC Machining Ordering Sheet Metal Ordering CNC Machining Materials Aluminum CNC Machining Copper CNC Machining Plastic CNC Machining Stainless Steel CNC Machining Steel Alloy CNC Machining Sheet Metal Materials Aluminum Stainless Steel Alloy Steel CNC Machining Tutorials CNC Machining Design CNC Machining Knowledge Sheet Metal Tutorials Sheet Metal Design CNC Machine Basic Knowledge 5-Axis CNC Machine Privacy&Policies Coupon Policy Shipping Policies Policies PMMA (Acrylic) CNC Machining Last updated on Jan 06, 2026 Acrylic, also known as PMMA or Plexiglas, is from the English acrylic (acrylic plastic), and is the chemical name of polymethyl methacrylate. Is an important early development of plastic polymer materials, with good transparency, chemical stability, and weather resistance, easy to dye, easy to process, and beautiful appearance, in the construction industry and has a wide range of applications. Plexiglass products can usually be divided into cast sheets, extruded sheets, and molded plastics. Mechanical Properties Polymethyl methacrylate has good overall mechanical properties and is at the forefront of general-purpose plastics. Its tensile, bending, and compression strengths are higher than those of polyolefins and higher than those of polystyrene and polyvinyl chloride, etc. Its impact toughness is poor, but it is also slightly better than that of polystyrene. The mechanical properties of tensile, bending, and compression are higher for cast polymerized polymethyl methacrylate sheets (such as plexiglass sheets for aviation), which can reach the level of polyamide, polycarbonate, and other engineering plastics. Generally speaking, the tensile strength of polymethyl methacrylate can reach the level of 50-77MPa and the bending strength can reach 90-130MPa, and the upper limit of these performance data has reached or even exceeded some engineering plastics. Its elongation at break is only 2%-3%, so the mechanical properties are basically hard and brittle plastic and have a gap sensitivity, easy to crack under stress, but the fracture is not as sharp and uneven as polystyrene and ordinary inorganic glass. 40 ℃ is a secondary transition temperature, which is equivalent to the temperature at which the side methyl starts to move, and over 40 ℃, the toughness of the material, and ductility improved. Polymethyl methacrylate has low surface hardness and is easily scuffed. The strength of polymethyl methacrylate is related to the time of stress action and decreases with the increase of action time. The mechanical properties of polymethyl methacrylate (oriented plexiglass) after tensile orientation are significantly improved and notch sensitivity is also improved. The heat resistance of polymethyl methacrylate is not high. Although its glass transition temperature reaches 104°C, the maximum continuous use temperature changes between 65°C and 95°C with different working conditions, the heat deflection temperature is about 96°C (1.18 MPa), and the Vicat softening point is about 113°C. Heat resistance can be improved by copolymerization of monomer with acrylate methacrylate or glycol bis-ester acrylate. The cold resistance of polymethyl methacrylate is also poor, with a brittleness temperature of about 9.2°C. The thermal stability of polymethyl methacrylate is medium, better than polyvinyl chloride and polyformaldehyde, but less than polyolefin and polystyrene, thermal decomposition temperature is slightly higher than 270 ℃, its flow temperature is about 160 ℃, so there is still a wide range of melt processing temperature. The thermal conductivity and specific heat capacity of polymethyl methacrylate are medium in plastics, 0.19W/M.K and 1464J/Kg.K respectively. Was this article helpful? Yes No Help Center

We are dedicated to providing the high-precision, stable, and reliable CNC manufacturing services your projects demand. Following a comprehensive evaluation of current market conditions, JLCCNC will implement a price adjustment for our CNC machining services, effective May 8, 2026 (18:00 UTC+8) . This decision is driven by sustained and significant cost increases in core raw materials and manufacturing consumables. Core Reasons for Adjustment ● Surge in Tooling Costs: The price of Tungsten Powder—the primary raw material for high-performance CNC cutting tools—has surged by 491% year-over-year. Verify Now Blog > Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay Corporate Social Responsibility of PCBWay by: PCBWay May 30,2025 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay recognizes the significant role it plays within the supply chain and broader society, along with the potential impact of its operations. To this end, we have established and strictly enforce the following principles, which not only govern our own conduct but also set clear expectations for our partners. Our goal is to ensure full legal and regulatory compliance, promote long-term sustainability, and generate a positive impact on society. Human Rights and Labor Protection No employment of individuals below the legal working age; all forms of forced or bonded labor are strictly prohibited. Discrimination and harassment in the workplace are not tolerated; an inclusive work environment for persons with disabilities is encouraged. Employees must be provided with fair compensation and reasonable rest periods, and their rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining must be respected. Business Ethics and Compliance Offering, promising, soliciting, or accepting any form of bribery is strictly prohibited; effective conflict of interest management and whistleblowing mechanisms must be in place. All financial and business records must accurately, completely, and truthfully reflect the underlying transactions. Full compliance with international sanctions, export controls, and other applicable laws and regulations is required. Supply Chain Responsibility and Sustainable Procurement PCBWay and its partners are required to extend the principles outlined in this document to all levels of entities within the supply chain. Priority should be given to selecting partners that are legally compliant, socially responsible, and committed to sustainable development. Identify social, labor, and environmental risks related to operations, and develop corresponding control and mitigation measures. Encourage partners to prioritize local sourcing to support regional economic development and job creation. Environmental Protection and Workplace Safety Actively implement environmental protection measures and continuously promote energy conservation and emission reduction; Ensure that all waste and hazardous materials are disposed of in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. The procurement or use of prohibited materials is not allowed. Provide employees with a safe working environment and health support mechanisms to prevent occupational injuries and health risks. PCBWay has fully adopted the DHL GoGreen transportation service in 2025 to reduce carbon emissions in the supply chain and promote the development of a green supply chain, with an initial target of reducing emissions by 30%. Information Protection and Transparent Governance Establish a comprehensive security system to strictly protect the confidentiality of customer data, drawings, and other business information. Comply with relevant laws and regulations to safeguard the personal data of customers and employees. Ensure that financial records are true, accurate, and complete, and prohibit any illegal activities. PCBWay will ensure the implementation of the above principles in actual cooperation and reserves the right to take action against any violations. Verify Now Blog > Extrude: Check Your 3D Models on Your Phone Before Printing Extrude: Check Your 3D Models on Your Phone Before Printing by: Mila Nov 19,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Before starting a 3D print, it's worth checking your model's dimensions, structure, and printability. But what if you could do all of this directly on your phone? Meet Extrude, a free 3D model viewer app for iPhone, iPad, and Android, designed to help makers inspect their 3D models anytime, anywhere. What Is Extrude? Extrude supports a wide range of 3D file formats, including STL, 3MF, OBJ, PLY, GLB, and G-code. You can open files directly on your phone, even offline, without creating an account or uploading anything. Your files stay on your device. Extrude also includes several tools to help you prepare your models for printing: View & Measure: View 3D models and measure their dimensions. Print Check: Check printer bed fit and wall thickness. Print Estimates: Estimate printing time and filament usage. Section View: Inspect the internal structure of 3D models. AR Preview: View models at actual size in your surroundings. Available in 27 languages, Extrude is continuing to grow its user community among makers worldwide. Extrude x PCBWay: From Digital Models to Physical Parts Not every project can be completed with a desktop 3D printer. Sometimes you need a larger part, different materials, or more precise manufacturing. That's where PCBWay comes in! Starting November 23, 2026, Extrude users will see a PCBWay banner directly in the 3D viewer. Through this collaboration, users can discover PCBWay's professional manufacturing services, including 3D printing and CNC machining, with over 100 material options! Try Extrude Today! Want to inspect your 3D models more conveniently? Give Extrude a try! Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad PCBWay Plug-In for KiCad by: Anson Apr 01,2022 Posted in News Kicad PCB design Send your layout to PCBWay for instant production with just one click. Have you ever thought that when you complete the design on KiCad, you can place an order on pcbway with just one click? Now this idea is finally achieved (it's not an April Fool's joke). When you click PCBWay Plug-in button on Kicad, we will export these files in your project ( Please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin released at 2026 )： 1.Gerber files in correct format for production 2.IPC-Netlist file 3.Bom-file that includes all information of components 4.Pick and Place-file used in assembly You can click "Save to Cart" to place an order immediately after uploading the files( usually only takes a few seconds), our engineers will double check the files before the production. Note:We have updated plugin for Kicad 10,you could also place assembly order directly now. But we need to get the component "Manufacture Part Number". Please confirm you run the "Update Board from Schematic" and install the latest version of the plugin. ﻿ Installation from the official KiCad repositories Just open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the KiCad main menu an install the "PCBWay Plug-in for KiCad" plugin from the selection list. Manual installation You can also download the latest ZIP file from https://github.com/pcbway/PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kicad , then open the "Plugin and Content Manager" from the main window of KiCad and install the ZIP file via "Install from File". About Bom We can get all information of components used in your design ( please make sure you have installed the latest version of the plugin) . In order to speed up the quotation of components, we need this information: 1. Designator (necessary) 2. Quantity (necessary) 3. MPN/Part Number (necessary) 4. Package/Footprint (necessary) 5. Manufacturer (optional) 6. Description/value (optional) You just need to add the properties in your schematic like the picture shows: As a sponsor of KiCad, we will always support its development. events.page_title: ABS CNC Machining
events.summary: 板块文案更新：ABS CNC Machining
events.before: ABS CNC Machining Last updated on Jun 14, 2025 ABS engineering plastic is PC+ABS (engineering plastic alloy), the Chinese name in the chemical industry called a plastic alloy, the reason for the name PC+ABS, is that this material has both excellent heat and weather resistance, dimensional stability, and impact resistance properties of PC resin, but also has excellent processing fluidity of ABS resin. The biggest disadvantage of ABS engineering plastic is its heavy mass and poor thermal conductivity. Its molding temperature is taken from the temperature between the two raw materials, that is, 240-265 degrees, the temperature is too high ABS will decompose, and too low PC material mobility is not good. Mechanical properties ABS has excellent mechanical properties, its impact strength is excellent, and can be used at very low temperatures: ABS has excellent wear resistance, good dimensional stability, and oil resistance, and can be used for bearings under medium load and speed. The mechanical properties of ABS are greatly affected by temperature.
